findings.title: Prime gap deviation shape characterization
findings.finding: Deviation NARROWER than Exp(1): both tails lighter, mid-bins over-represented. BH-FDR 40-cell: 38/40 significant.
findings.honest_framing: We characterize the shape, not the cause. No mechanism identified.

findings.title: AI pareidolia spectral threshold
findings.finding: Detection threshold at complexity >= 0.05 (5% FFT bins), not 0.10 as documented.
findings.honest_framing: AI perception tracks spectral statistics, not information content.

findings.title: Detector de-biasing validation
findings.finding: Corrections <5% per factor; A==B robust; REBUS NOT detector artifact.
findings.controls: A==B robustness PASS, dose-response shape PASS, per-factor corrections PASS
findings.honest_framing: Proves detector bias is not responsible. Does not prove REBUS causes pareidolia.

findings.title: REBUS dose-response quantification
findings.controls: A==B consistency PASS, Hill fit quality PASS, baseline match PASS

findings.title: Collatz parameter sensitivity
findings.finding: Convergence iff a=b=c. All 3 (a=b=c) families: 100% convergence at N=100000 (150,000 starting values). All 5 (a!=b or c!=a) families: 0% convergence at N=1000.
findings.honest_framing: Convergence iff a=b=c confirmed at N=100000. Full 27-family sweep pending compute.

findings.title: D1 deviation persists at 10^9
findings.finding: 4/4 blocks significant at 10^9 (50.8M primes). chi2/dof increases 2.3x from 10^8. Not a finite-range artifact.
findings.controls: Same pipeline as EXP-0008; BH-FDR at alpha=0.01
findings.honest_framing: Deviation persists at 10^9. 10^10 run in progress.
